raw: {"ticket": "Hi, this is Sarah from the nonprofit outreach team — we’ve been using Northbeam for about a year now, and I’ve been the main admin setting up SSO since we switched over last October, and honestly it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster from day one, like the first time we tried SSO it took us three weeks to get it working because the IDP docs were outdated, but we finally made it, and I even gave a presentation at the regional nonprofit tech summit about how we did it, which was really nice, but now I’ve got a problem — I can’t log in at all, I keep getting stuck in this loop where I enter my password and it just brings me back to the login screen, and I’ve tried resetting it five times, and I’ve also lost my 2FA device because I left it in a cab last week, and I don’t have access to my backup codes anymore because they were on a piece of paper I put in my desk drawer and now it’s been moved during our office reorganization, so I’m completely locked out, and I need to get back in because I’m the only one who’s set up SSO and I don’t know who else has admin access, and I’m really worried about what’s going on with the team’s data if I can’t get in, and I know I should’ve backed up the codes, but I didn’t think it would come to this, and I’m panicking a little bit because we’ve got a donor report due in two days and I can’t pull the project data without logging in, but I’m not sure if this is urgent enough to escalate, but I just need to get in so I can fix things before something worse happens, please help.", "category": "account_access", "priority": "P2", "rationale": "The ticket describes a single user (the admin) being fully blocked from accessing their account due to a forgotten password loop and lost 2FA device, which falls under the default P2 priority for account_access tickets unless a breach is suspected, which is not indicated here."}

{"ticket": "We've just enabled SSO for our team, but now the calendar sync is failing for everyone—events aren't showing up, and we're having to manually update schedules. We're frustrated because we're considering switching to a competitor, but we've temporarily worked around it by exporting and re-importing events daily.", "category": "technical_issue", "priority": "P2", "rationale": "The customer's workflow is blocked with no workaround available (despite mentioning a workaround, the issue affects the whole team and prevents core functionality, making it a P2 technical_issue per the policy").}

{"ticket": "Hey, I’ve been using Northbeam for my freelance design business for about two years now and honestly, it’s been a game-changer—I’ve built up so many client projects and tracked every hour, and I literally can’t access my account right now because I just got a new phone and my old one got stolen last week, so I lost my 2FA authenticator app, and I tried resetting my password like five times but every time I go through the reset link, it just loops me back to the login page with no error message, and I’ve tried checking my spam folder and even going to the recovery email but I haven’t received anything, and I’m super stressed because I’ve got a proposal due tomorrow for a big client and I need to pull up the last invoice I sent and I can’t even get into the system, I don’t know if I’m doing something wrong or if Northbeam’s broken or what, I’ve never had this issue before and I feel like I’m going to lose this client because I can’t show my work history, and I just need to get in somehow, it’s not like I’m trying to change anything, I just want to log in like normal, but it’s stuck in this endless loop and I’ve tried all the usual fixes but nothing works, I even tried clearing cache and using a different browser, and my old phone was a dead phone anyway so I didn’t even have the 2FA app on it anymore, so I’m completely locked out, and I don’t know what to do, I’m just stuck here, and I don’t think it’s a big deal but it’s my only way to work right now so I’m really anxious about this, and I don’t know if you can help me or if I need to go through some kind of security process, I just want to get back into my account, please help.", "category": "account_access", "priority": "P2", "rationale": "A single user fully blocked from working is P2, and this ticket describes a single user unable to log in due to lost 2FA device and password reset loop, which falls under the default P2 priority for account_access tickets unless a breach is suspected."}

{"ticket": "We need all our data exported for compliance. How long will this take?", "category": "data_request", "priority": "P3", "rationale": "All data_request tickets are P3 due to the 30-day statutory clock, not an emergency."}
